item.description:
Fixes the following security issues: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-48060 https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8mxc-vqrq-gcm8 https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-23337

Fixes needed backporting to apply. Commits can't be fetched using fetchpatch, because jq is part of bootstrap on darwin.

Upstream commits included: https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/a09a4dfd55e6c24d04b35062ccfe4509748b1dd3 (CVE-2024-53427) https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/de21386681c0df0104a99d9d09db23a9b2a78b1e (CVE-2024-23337) https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/dc849e9bb74a7a164a3ea52f661cc712b1ffbd43 (CVE-2025-48060) https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/b86ff49f46a4a37e5a8e75a140cb5fd6e1331384 (needed for the NaN patches to apply)

See also upstream issue: https://github.com/jqlang/jq/issues/3327

Closes https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/411881

cc @NixOS/darwin-core because this is part of darwin bootstrap.
